Preprocess Illumina 10X Genomics GEX / CITE-seq / HTO data by sample - from Cell Ranger demultiplexed/filtered matrix

+ CITE-seq: cell-surface protein measurements
+ Cell Hashing: tagged antibodies against ubiquitous cell surface proteins to multiplex samples

Code adapted from:

+ https://satijalab.org/seurat/articles/hashing_vignette
+ https://satijalab.org/seurat/articles/multimodal_vignette
+ Meijie/Shaoli code (CCRGB-42)
+ https://github.com/niaid/dsb

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
#knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir =  "/data/khanlab3/gb_omics/projects/khan/ccrgb_6/analysis/")
#knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, dev="png",fig.path="masih/",fig.height=5,fig.width=7)

library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(dsb)
```

# Create Seurat object

## Read h5 file location from command line

```{r}
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)

if (length(args) > 0) {
  sample <- args[1]
  location <- args[2]

  h5_file <- paste(location,sample,sep="/")
} else {
  sample <- "GPC2_CD276_BisCAR_CTRL_TIL_rep1"
  h5_file <- "/data/khanlab3/gb_omics/projects/khan/ccrgb_95/analysis/BiCisCar/cellranger/GPC2_CD276_BisCAR_CTRL/outs/per_sample_outs/CTRL_TIL_rep1/count/sample_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5"
}
print(paste("Using input file:", h5_file))
```

## Load h5 data

Assumes data includes only shared barcodes

```{r}
sample.data <- Read10X_h5(h5_file)

# Simplify feature names
rownames(sample.data[["Antibody Capture"]]) <- gsub(pattern = "_*TotalSeqC", replacement = "",rownames(sample.data[["Antibody Capture"]]))
```

## Create Seurat object 

Initialize with RNA, add ADT assay 

```{r}
seurat_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = sample.data[["Gene Expression"]],project=sample)
seurat_obj[["ADT"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = sample.data[["Antibody Capture"]])
```

# Normalize data 

Log normalization for RNA, CLR transformation for antibodies

+ HTO: margin=1 for normalization across feature
+ CITE-seq: margin=2 for normalization within the cell, accounts for differences in ADT depth across cells (https://github.com/satijalab/seurat/issues/8159)
* Overwritten by DSB normalization

```{r}
seurat_obj <- NormalizeData(seurat_obj)
seurat_obj <- NormalizeData(seurat_obj, assay = "ADT", normalization.method = "CLR", margin = 2)
```

# ADT normalization with DSB

Removes ambient noise WITHOUT empty droplets and uses non-specific isotype controls to remove inter-cell technical variation

```{r}
isotypes = c("Mm-IgG1-Kappa-isotype-Ctrl","Mm-IgG2a-Kappa-isotype-Ctrl","Mm-IgG2b-Kappa-isotype-Ctrl")

seurat_obj[["ADT"]]$data = ModelNegativeADTnorm(cell_protein_matrix = seurat_obj[["ADT"]]$counts, 
                                     denoise.counts = TRUE,
                                     use.isotype.control = TRUE, 
                                     isotype.control.name.vec = isotypes)
```

# GEX QC and filtering

Adjust hardcoded filters

```{r}
seurat_obj[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat_obj, assay = "RNA", pattern = "^MT-")

VlnPlot(seurat_obj, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"))
hist(seurat_obj$nFeature_RNA)
hist(seurat_obj$percent.mt)

seurat_obj.filtered <- subset(seurat_obj, subset = nFeature_RNA > 400 & nFeature_RNA < 8000 & percent.mt < 20)
VlnPlot(seurat_obj.filtered, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3)
```

# Save object

```{r}
saveRDS(seurat_obj, file = "sample.singlet.rds")
saveRDS(seurat_obj.filtered, file = "sample.singlet.filtered.rds")
```
